name: Truncate
description: `Truncate` applies single-line overflow truncation while preserving the full value in the native `title` tooltip.

props.name: as
props.description: Element or component to render, such as `Link` for a truncated link. Components also receive `inline`.

props.name: expandable
props.description: Reveals the full text on hover and focus.

props.name: href
props.description: URL to navigate to when `as` renders a link.

props.name: inline
props.description: Renders inline rather than as a block.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Width past which the text is clipped.

props.name: title
props.description: Full text, shown on hover and kept available to assistive technology when the text is clipped.
